properties.name: Idaho
properties.note: Idaho scopes named in the Pacific Northwest hierarchy: Coeur d'Alene, the panhandle, Lewis-Clark, and Boise. The rest of Idaho is on the Intermountain West map.

properties.name: Boise, Meridian, Nampa, Caldwell
properties.note: Ada and Canyon counties: Boise, Meridian, Nampa, and Caldwell. This is the scope that also carries pnw.

properties.name: Coeur d'Alene / N. Idaho panhandle
properties.note: From the Pacific Northwest hierarchy. Boundary, Bonner, Kootenai, Benewah, and Shoshone counties: Sandpoint, Coeur d'Alene, and the Silver Valley.

properties.name: Northern Idaho (Moscow, Lewiston, Clearwater)
properties.note: From the Pacific Northwest hierarchy. The Palouse and Clearwater are the local scope; Idaho County stays on n-id.

properties.name: Lewiston / Moscow / Clearwater
properties.note: From the Pacific Northwest hierarchy. Latah, Nez Perce, Lewis, and Clearwater counties.

properties.name: University of Idaho, Moscow campus
properties.note: Campus-only scope from the Pacific Northwest hierarchy. Drawn as the Moscow campus, inside lws.

properties.name: Western US / SW Canada
properties.note: Root scope on this map. Drawn as the Pacific Northwest coverage: Washington, Oregon, southern British Columbia, the Flathead, northern Idaho, and Boise.

properties.name: Pacific Northwest
properties.note: Washington, Oregon, southern British Columbia, the Flathead, northern Idaho, and the Boise metro. Southern and eastern Idaho stay on imw except for Boise.

properties.name: Washington
properties.note: State scope. Five regional scopes tile Washington.

properties.name: Oregon
properties.note: State scope. Portland, the Willamette, the coast, southern Oregon, and central Oregon tile the state.

properties.name: British Columbia (southern)
properties.note: Southern coast only: the Lower Mainland and Vancouver Island. The interior and the north are outside this hierarchy.

properties.name: Montana (partial)
properties.note: Partial on purpose. Flathead, Lake, and Glacier counties are the Flathead Valley scope. Lincoln and Sanders stay on mt so the northwest corner is not left off the map.

properties.name: Flathead Valley / Kalispell / Glacier
properties.note: Flathead and Lake counties hold Kalispell and Flathead Lake. Glacier County stays with them for the park side of the valley.

properties.name: Western Washington
properties.note: Puget Sound and the coast. The Olympic Peninsula, Hood Canal, Whidbey, and the San Juans stay on w-wa outside the named city scopes.

properties.name: Southwest Washington
properties.note: Lewis and Cowlitz have city scopes. Clark, Skamania, and Wahkiakum stay on sw-wa. Clark County also sits inside the Portland metro outline.

properties.name: Central Washington
properties.note: Yakima, Wenatchee, Ellensburg, and Ephrata have city scopes. Douglas County stays with Wenatchee. Okanogan and Klickitat stay on c-wa.

properties.name: Eastern Washington
properties.note: Spokane and the counties north and west of it. The WSU Pullman tag is a campus dot here even though Pullman the city is in se-wa.

properties.name: Southeastern Washington
properties.note: Walla Walla, the Palouse, and the Tri-Cities. Columbia County stays with Walla Walla.

properties.name: Seattle / Tacoma / Bellevue
properties.note: King, Pierce, and Snohomish counties.

properties.name: Olympia / Lacey / Tumwater
properties.note: Thurston County.

properties.name: Kitsap / Bremerton / Silverdale
properties.note: Kitsap County.

properties.name: Grays Harbor / WA coast
properties.note: Grays Harbor and Pacific counties, the outer coast south of the Olympic Peninsula.

properties.name: Skagit Valley / Mount Vernon / Anacortes
properties.note: Skagit County.

properties.name: Bellingham / Whatcom County
properties.note: Whatcom County.

properties.name: Centralia / Chehalis
properties.note: Lewis County.

properties.name: Kelso / Longview
properties.note: Cowlitz County.

properties.name: Yakima
properties.note: Yakima County.

properties.name: Wenatchee
properties.note: Chelan County holds Wenatchee. Douglas County stays with it for East Wenatchee.

properties.name: Ellensburg
properties.note: Kittitas County.

properties.name: Ephrata
properties.note: Grant County. Ephrata is the named seat; Moses Lake is in the same county.

properties.name: Spokane metro
properties.note: Spokane County.

properties.name: WSU Pullman campus
properties.note: Campus-only tag. The dot is the Pullman campus. The city around it is puw, under se-wa.

properties.name: Walla Walla
properties.note: Walla Walla County. Columbia County (Dayton) stays with it.

properties.name: Pullman (Whitman, Asotin, Garfield)
properties.note: The Washington side of the Palouse.

properties.name: Tri-Cities / Pasco / Kennewick / Richland
properties.note: Benton and Franklin counties.

properties.name: Portland metro (OR + Clark County WA)
properties.note: Multnomah, Washington, Clackamas, and Columbia counties, plus Clark County, Washington. Clark also remains inside sw-wa.

properties.name: Willamette Valley
properties.note: The valley from Yamhill County through Lane County. Lane includes the Florence side of the coast range.

properties.name: Southern Oregon
properties.note: Medford, Grants Pass, Roseburg, and Klamath Falls. Lake County stays on s-or.

properties.name: Oregon Coast
properties.note: The coast counties. Curry County, south of Coos Bay, stays on coast-or.

properties.name: Central Oregon
properties.note: Bend, Pendleton, and Baker City have city scopes. The rest of the interior, the Columbia Plateau, and the gorge counties stay on c-or.

properties.name: McMinnville / Yamhill
properties.note: Yamhill County.

properties.name: Salem / Keizer
properties.note: Marion and Polk counties.

properties.name: Corvallis / Albany
properties.note: Benton and Linn counties.

properties.name: Eugene / Springfield
properties.note: Lane County.

properties.name: Medford / Ashland
properties.note: Jackson County holds Medford and Ashland. Josephine County (Grants Pass) stays with the Rogue Valley.

properties.name: Roseburg
properties.note: Douglas County.

properties.name: Klamath Falls
properties.note: Klamath County.

properties.name: Astoria / Seaside
properties.note: Clatsop County.

properties.name: Tillamook
properties.note: Tillamook County.

properties.name: Newport / Lincoln City
properties.note: Lincoln County.

properties.name: North Bend / Coos Bay
properties.note: Coos County.

properties.name: Bend / Redmond
properties.note: Deschutes County. The tag is bend, the short full name used in the hierarchy's quick reference.

properties.name: Pendleton
properties.note: Umatilla County. Wallowa County operators are described as dual-carrying palouse on this tag; the county itself is drawn with palouse.

properties.name: Baker City
properties.note: Baker County.

properties.name: Southwest BC / Lower Mainland
properties.note: Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley regional districts.

properties.name: Vancouver Island
properties.note: The island regional districts from the Capital through Comox and the west coast. Mount Waddington and Strathcona also sit with the island, but their official boundaries take in large mainland inlets, so they stay outside this outline.

properties.name: South Vancouver Island / Victoria
properties.note: Capital Regional District, including Victoria and the southern Gulf Islands.

properties.name: Inland Northwest
properties.note: Cross-border scope for Spokane and the Idaho panhandle. It overlaps geg and cda.

properties.name: Palouse
properties.note: Cross-border scope for the Washington Palouse, the Moscow–Lewiston–Clearwater corridor, and Wallowa County.

properties.name: Salish Sea / Gulf Islands
properties.note: A generalized outline of the Gulf Islands between Vancouver Island and the mainland. It overlaps vanisle and the edge of the Lower Mainland.
